description: Search Sightglass companies, what users call brands: the business behind one or more Meta advertiser pages, keyed on its domain. `search` is semantic: describe what the business sells and to whom. `similarToCompanyId` finds a company's nearest competitors. `domainSearch` looks a brand up by website; when it finds nothing the brand isn't tracked, so write one sentence on what it sells and to whom and pass that as `search` to get tracked brands competing for the same customers. Results carry store facts (platform, estimated monthly sales, products, employees, followers with 30-day change; all vendor estimates, never reported revenue), rank by active ads, and `momentum`, a 0-100 score whose `components[].text` say why a brand is growing. Sort by `momentum` for who is blowing up, `most_estimated_sales` for the biggest, `most_active_ads` for who runs the most ads. Trends cover only ads Sightglass has seen. Fields this workspace can't see are null and named in the item's `locked` list (`estimates` = sales, visits, traffic). A capped list sets `planLimit` (`maxResults`, `hiddenResults`) and has no next page. Never estimate omitted values. Returns data only, shown to no one. Once you know the answer, call sightglass_show once with this resultId to show it as cards; it doesn't search again. Works without a Replo account: call it before asking the user to sign in. For multi-step competitor research, call skills with name "replo".

categoryIds.description: CSV of category ids from sightglass_search_companies results; a node matches its whole subtree.

cursor.description: nextCursor from the previous page of this same call, to get the next page. Keep every other argument the same.

domainSearch.description: A brand's website, e.g. example.com or a full URL, to find that brand when Sightglass tracks it.

limit.description: Results per page: 20 by default, up to 40. Use the user's number when they give one; for more than 40, page with cursor.

projectId.description: Replo project id, from list_projects. Its workspace decides which Sightglass fields and history come back. Only tools that say they save something (an asset or a Canvas file) write to this project.

search.description: Semantic by default: describe the business (what it sells, to whom), not one keyword.

similarToCompanyId.description: Find the nearest competitors of this company instead of searching.

workspaceId.description: Replo workspace id, from list_workspaces. Decides which workspace's Sightglass fields and history come back; required when the user has more than one workspace.

name: sightglass_search_companies
title: Search brands
